subject: Coordination: Pricing & Dedicated sizing review — multi-stakeholder call
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Coordination: Pricing & Dedicated sizing review — multi-stakeholder call

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation, we'd like to schedule a 60-minute joint session to walk through:
- Your usage forecast and traffic profile (to validate Dedicated sizing)
- Pricing & packaging options (hosted vs. dedicated capacity + committed tiers)
- Security/compliance asks and procurement next steps

Proposed attendees: your infra/engineering lead, procurement, security; from our side: me (AE), Sean (SE) to lead the technical sizing, and Rishi for pricing & commercial context.

Suggested slots (PST):
- Tue Mar 9, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Mar 10, 13:00–14:00
- Thu Mar 11, 08:30–09:30

I've attached two pre-reads to speed the call: redwood-dedicated-sizing.xlsx (draft sizing worksheet) and usage-forecast-template.csv — if you can fill a short forecast ahead of time, Sean can validate the model during the call.

Agenda (30m sizing / 20m pricing / 10m next steps):
1) Quick intros and goals
2) Walk sizing workbook + confirm expected concurrency and peak QPS
3) Pricing buckets and trade-offs (committed capacity vs. burst credit)
4) Security evidence & procurement ask list

Can you confirm which of the slots works, and please loop in Procurement & Security so we have the right folks?

Thanks — looking forward.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0183

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sizing.xlsx, usage-forecast-template.csv

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Desai <p.desai@finova.com>, Mark Lowe <mark.lowe@finova.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Coordination: Pricing & Dedicated sizing review — multi-stakeholder call

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks — this looks good. We definitely want Procurement and Security on the call. Priya (security) and Mark (procurement) are cc'd. My engineering lead (Samir Patel) is out until the 11th, so he asked if we can move to Wed or Thu to ensure the right technical signals.

Of your three options, Wed Mar 10 at 13:00 PT works best for the rest of the team. One ask: can you provide a short preliminary pricing worksheet or ballpark committed capacity scenarios ahead of time so Procurement has something to review? We can also provide a baseline forecast by EOD Tue (I will ask Samir to fill the CSV, but if needed our team can send an export).

Also attaching our security questionnaire (trimmed) so Priya can flag any critical evidence she needs before the meeting.

—Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Platform Engineering | Finova Payments
alex.johnson@finova.com

Attachments: finova-security-questions.pdf

From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 03 Mar 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Coordination: Pricing & Dedicated sizing review — multi-stakeholder call

Vanessa / Rishi —

I'll take the technical lead on the call and validate the sizing workbook live. I made a few notes in the attached sizing spreadsheet (small edits) with example concurrency and cache-hit assumptions that usually move the Dedicated recommendation between 2–4 GPUs for a production storefront workload.

Action items from our side before Wed:
- I'll finalize the sizing workbook and reattach before the call
- Rishi, can you draft two commercial scenarios (12-mo committed, 24-mo committed with burst credits) and share a one-pager? I'll include your one-pager in the invite so Procurement sees it pre-read.
- Vanessa, please ask Alex if Samir can share the forecast CSV by EOD Tue — the more granular (daily QPS or medium-term monthly) the better.

I also added a short note about network/IP requirements we typically share with security teams; Priya, happy to send a one-page network snippet if that helps.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sizing.xlsx (v2)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finova.com>, Priya Desai <p.desai@finova.com>, Mark Lowe <mark.lowe@finova.com>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 04 Mar 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Confirmed: Wed Mar 10, 13:00 PT — Pricing & Dedicated sizing review (60m)

Thanks everyone — Wed Mar 10, 13:00–14:00 PT is confirmed. I've sent the calendar invite to all listed. 

Final agenda (to be shared in the invite):
- 13:00–13:05: Intros & goals (Vanessa)
- 13:05–13:35: Technical sizing review (Sean) — live edits to sizing workbook
- 13:35–13:55: Pricing & packaging scenarios (Rishi) — committed tiers, breakpoints, optional burst credits
- 13:55–14:00: Next steps & procurement checklist (Vanessa)

Pre-reads attached and links included in invite: redwood-dedicated-sizing.xlsx (latest), usage-forecast-template.csv, and a draft preliminary pricing sheet. Procurement: Mark, we uploaded a short DocuSign link with the non-binding pricing scenarios so your team can preview numbers and redlines: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/prelim-pricing-FN-1427

Security: Priya, Sean will send the one-page network/IP snippet separately — let us know if you need additional evidence (SOC2 artifact pointers, audit logs examples) before the call.

If anyone needs to move the time, please flag within 24 hours. Looking forward to a productive session.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com

Attachments: redwood-dedicated-sizing.xlsx, usage-forecast-template.csv

Thanks Vanessa — Wed works. Quick ask from Security: can you send a short network diagram or plain list of outbound IP ranges your Dedicated nodes use, plus the typical ports/protocols? If you have a one-pager of SOC2 artifact names (what we can request/provide under NDA) that would be great to have before the meeting.

Also we'll plan to have our identity engineer on the call for a 10-minute session if needed.

—Priya Desai
Senior Information Security Manager | Finova Payments
p.desai@finova.com
